Home · Safaris · Uganda

5 days | Queen Elizabeth and Bwindi gorillas

Package overview

Queen Elizabeth for classic game viewing and a boat, then Bwindi for one gorilla trek. The park permit is quoted separately because the fee is set by the park, not by us.

A first gorilla trek with a savannah park attached. Highlights: Kasenyi plains, Kazinga Channel boat, One Bwindi gorilla trek.

Route Entebbe → Queen Elizabeth → Bwindi → Entebbe

The Uganda gorilla permit is extra. The park fee is currently about USD 800 per person. We put the current figure on your quote.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Entebbe

Arrival and overnight near Entebbe. A Mabamba shoebill morning can be added only if your flight lands the day before.

Accommodation: Entebbe

02Day 2 | Queen Elizabeth

The road from Entebbe is a full day, about seven to eight hours. We recommend the scheduled flight when the budget allows. Afternoon drive on the Kasenyi plains if you arrive in time.

Accommodation: Queen Elizabeth

03Day 3 | Queen Elizabeth to Bwindi

Morning drive and a Kazinga Channel boat, then about five to six hours to Bwindi.

Accommodation: Bwindi

04Day 4 | Gorilla trek

A briefing at the park, then a walk with rangers to one habituated family. You spend one hour with them. The walk itself can be two hours or most of the day.

Accommodation: Bwindi

05Day 5 | Return to Entebbe

Road, or a flight connection via Kihihi or Kisoro when seats exist.

Accommodation: Departure

Where you sleep

Budget is a permanent tent or a simple lodge. Mid-range is an en-suite lodge or tented camp. Luxury is a smaller camp and, where it helps, a flight between parks. The camp names are written on your quote.

What's included

  • Accommodation on the plan we send you
  • Meals noted in the day-by-day itinerary
  • A private 4x4 with a pop-up roof and an English-speaking guide
  • Park and conservancy fees for the places on the itinerary
  • Arrival and departure transfers in the city where the trip starts
  • Bottled drinking water in the vehicle

What's excluded

  • International flights
  • Visas, vaccinations and travel insurance
  • Gorilla and chimpanzee permits, unless your quote includes them
  • Tips, laundry, premium drinks and personal purchases
  • Balloon flights, extra activities and community visits
